# Who Owns the Archive? — motion and channel evidence manifest

Version 2.0 · RN Collins · 7 September 2026

## Reels / TikTok / Shorts
### 0–8s — OBJ-159187
Voiceover: The record separates the material dress, House of Worth attribution, Charles Frederick Worth design credit, accession, and the museum’s present custody.

Treatment: slow evidence push; no synthetic parallax

Credit: Brooklyn Museum Costume Collection at The Metropolitan Museum of Art, Gift of the Brooklyn Museum, 2009; Gift of the Princess Viggo in accordance with the wishes of the Misses Hewitt, 1931

Rights: Public Domain / Met Open Access

### 8–16s — CO04-DIAGRAM-1
Voiceover: 01 · INVENTORY — What is actually here?. Assign a persistent identifier to each object, file, recording, agreement, credential, and related record. Preserve original order and provenance before reorganizing for convenience.

Treatment: vertical reveal with source footer

Credit: Concept and editorial design: RN Collins

Rights: Original publication graphic; no third-party imagery

### 16–24s — CO04-DIAGRAM-2
Voiceover: 02 · SEPARATE — Which interest attaches to which item?. Record physical title, copyright authorship and transfers, trademark or design records, contract limits, privacy, access, and conservation separately. One accession row may need several rights rows.

Treatment: slow evidence push; no synthetic parallax

Credit: Concept and editorial design: RN Collins

Rights: Original publication graphic; no third-party imagery

### 24–32s — CO04-DIAGRAM-3
Voiceover: 03 · GOVERN — Who may possess, use, reproduce, lend, digitize, describe, and dispose?. Turn vague control into verbs, responsible parties, territory, term, approval, exceptions, recovery, and a source document. Unknown is a valid status; guessed ownership is not.

Treatment: vertical reveal with source footer

Credit: Concept and editorial design: RN Collins

Rights: Original publication graphic; no third-party imagery

### 32–40s — CO04-DIAGRAM-4
Voiceover: 04 · STEWARD — What must remain usable after a transfer?. Require identifiers, checksums, condition notes, formats, contextual narration, rights evidence, audit history, and a correction route to travel with the archive.

Treatment: slow evidence push; no synthetic parallax

Credit: Concept and editorial design: RN Collins

Rights: Original publication graphic; no third-party imagery

### 40–48s — S08
Voiceover: Personal Digital Archiving is retained as evidence, education, reporting or rights context.

Treatment: vertical reveal with source footer

Credit: Library of Congress

Rights: Link and quote narrowly; check each downloadable resource before redistribution.
